machine.fs_caveat: Timings were taken on a tmpfs measurement copy; the real repository lives on ext4. Filesystem-metadata costs (lock-file creation, fsync, atomic rename) are understated when measurement_fs is faster than repo_real_fs. The dominant cost (minor page faults / memory materialization) is filesystem-independent and reproduces on any backing store.

corpus.source: freshly generated fixture: `jit init` then `jit issue create` x issue_count, each a leaf task; corpus.bulk_group.matched_count of them carry label corpus.bulk_group.label for the bulk-mutation scenario (corpus.bulk_group.noop_count created already at the target priority, confirmed no-ops; corpus.bulk_group.change_count created off-target so they genuinely change); both mutable scenarios re-copy this pristine tree before every measured sample

method.tool: python3 time.perf_counter around subprocess.run, wall-clock milliseconds
method.cache_state: warm (page cache primed by warmup runs); cold-cache not measured because dropping the page cache needs root

commands.name: issue_show_single_read
commands.note: reads one issue without creating a per-issue sidecar lock

commands.name: query_available
commands.note: reads all issues without creating per-issue sidecar locks

commands.name: issue_update_mutation
commands.note: fresh fixture materialized before every measured sample so no sample observes a prior mutation

commands.name: issue_update_bulk_mutation_k30_j15
commands.note: fresh fixture materialized before every measured sample so no sample observes a prior mutation (same reset protocol as issue_update_mutation); 30 issues match --filter "label:component:bulk-target" (K), of which 15 already hold the target priority and are confirmed no-ops by the eligibility prefilter's shared verification session, and 15 (J) genuinely change and each open their own preflight+publication session

mutation_syscall_summary.interpretation: perf stat fields recorded for one freshly materialized single-issue mutation

lock_mechanism.per_issue_lock_site: none (the measured commit has no per-issue sidecar read lock)
lock_mechanism.creator: not applicable; load_issue creates no per-issue sidecar
lock_mechanism.never_removed: not applicable; no per-issue sidecar is created
lock_mechanism.cleanup_scope: legacy per-issue sidecars are removed once by the read-all path
lock_mechanism.writes_are_atomic: issue JSON is published by temp-file plus atomic rename; repository mutations serialize on .jit/.repo-write.lock
